name: Navid Mohammadi
principles: AI-assisted work with human review and tested outputs

bullets: Own independent engagements from ambiguous requirements and architecture through implementation, debugging, delivery, and long-term refinement across Windows, Linux, and web platforms.
In hardware-backed projects, owned board design, interface definition, and the coordinated development of device and application software.
Select languages, frameworks, data stores, and automation around the constraints of each problem instead of forcing one preferred stack.
Performed security analysis, penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and patch development for government IT infrastructure.
Turned findings into reproducible technical evidence, actionable remediation, and fixes that infrastructure stakeholders could apply and verify.
Connected application, network, dependency, and operational risk rather than treating security as an isolated reporting activity.
Co-founded the company and shared responsibility for technical direction, implementation, problem resolution, and delivery.
Developed scalable distributed applications for mobile and web using NoSQL databases and service-oriented boundaries.
Carried projects through integration and the successful completion of the company’s final obligations.

academicProfile.overview: Academic inquiry is a continuing part of my engineering practice, not a single publication. I use research to question assumptions, compare methods, and connect practical AI work to stronger evidence.
academicProfile.continuousPractice: I continually review academic papers and technical literature in artificial intelligence and data science, and participate in university workshops and academic sessions to keep research and implementation connected.
